title: Best Brand Voice Writers (2026): Tone of Voice Guides
h1: Best Brand Voice and Tone Writers
description: How to hire a brand voice writer for a tone of voice guide, messaging and word lists: examples, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Brand voice writers define how your brand sounds in words: the personality, tone, vocabulary and rules your team follows across websites, emails, social posts and support. A clear voice makes every message feel like it comes from the same company. Projects go wrong when the guide is too abstract, has no real examples, or does not match how the business actually talks to customers. This guide helps you get a voice guide your team will use.

faq.q: What is in a brand voice guide?
faq.a: Usually personality traits, tone for different situations, words to use and avoid, and before-and-after examples.

faq.q: How is voice different from tone?
faq.a: Voice is your consistent personality. Tone changes with the situation, such as a friendly welcome versus a careful apology.

faq.q: Do we need a guide if we are small?
faq.a: Even a short guide helps when several people write for you or when you hire freelancers.

faq.q: Will the writer rewrite our content too?
faq.a: Some include sample rewrites. Full content rewriting is usually a separate project.

faq.q: How will the team use it?
faq.a: Ask for a short, practical guide with examples, not a long theory document.
